description: Estimate the current USD gas cost of a specific Ethereum mainnet action (ETH transfer, ERC-20/USDC transfer, Uniswap swap, or NFT mint), or a custom gas-units amount, at the chosen priority tier.

action.description: The transaction type. Use "custom" with gas_units for anything else.

gas_units.description: Required when action is "custom": the gas units the transaction uses.

tier.description: Priority tier: low (cheapest), average, or high (fastest).

name: estimate_transaction_cost
